captions.text: One boy in blue shorts is about to throw something at another boy. While third jumps in air not trying to resolve the conflict, selfish.
The dog looks a bit too excited to see the frisbee that he has been seeing for last 5 years
The boy lays on top of pool of blue balls and laughs as if he swims in seas of jokes
The hobo strides down the street and pays no attention to the camera. He lives in a happy world of his own
A dark brown dog strives to run through sand. His eyes full of sadness and it seems he is all by himself on this run
The old man sits lonely on the bench looking away and probably thinking about regrets and mistakes, no one to accompany him
A bike racer slides along dirt as he has fallen while the other passes by, noting him but sadly cant help the fellow human. Tragedy but a reality.
The man looks to the right with a tension in his gaze and seriousness on his face
The boy jumps and dances in the train while the woman besides him enjoys the moment
The boy looks at the cakes and lets out a cry. He acts as if he can not live without eating those cakes.
A couple stand outside a wine shop late at night having a good time and each other's company to enjoy
The boy jumps from a height and wonders what would become of him if it goes wrong. Th sun adds to the poetic setting.
The man stands beside a wall in shade but his expressions do not look relaxed
The man and the woman pose for the photo but the old lady sits behind them feeling left out and un attended.
The lady stands on top of a tall wooden stamp and can't find either the courage or the path to come back down
A woman in red jacket poses to take a picture with a white tower. Her trip has paid off and she has loved it
A boy in black has committed to jump but has realized that he is alone in it. His friend stands behind alone.
The two dogs run stupidly into the pond with no idea of its depth. They will be introduced to the deep water soon
The skier has jumped far high into the sky and his fate depends on his landing skills.
The young swimmer looks with focus into the pool. She is planning out her own path, focussed nevertheless
Boy with a skateboard jumps over the small post. The evening light and the clean pavement witness the beauty of the parkour
The surfer lifts above the water. That's the beauty of it, she is surfing but leaves splashes of water behind to gain new height.
Four kids on a football ground try to simulate a match. With no where enough players, most of the pitch stands empty
The girl with a fake mustache and beard looks at the camera thinking that she can fool everyone with the disguise
Many boys swim in a pond far away from the camera. None of them seems to enjoy it, rather do it out of necessity.
The child in yellow shirt climbs into the slide from wrong side hoping to discover something new
The boys leaps towards the ball as a last hope but it is already destined to hit the fence. He has lost the point
The dog barks and runs at the huge waves about to crush at the shore as birds fly opposite. The dog is stern in resolve.
One dog jumps over the fence and other stands behind. They are making best of the their playtime at the park
A girl with a jacket kicks the gravel beneath her feet. Immersed in her own company and the smooth patch sun.
The girls are playing beach ball and one of them is hyper tuned on to the ball in air. She aims to hit it perfectly
Two girls enjoy on the shallow side of the pond. They are putting their swimming skills to good use
The white dog with black spots loves his time spent at the beach in the sand. His runs are the evidence of happiness.
Man stands proudly next to his bird cage. Im sure he shares a deep bond with the bird and cares for it
A disabled man in wheelchair leads the cycle race. A victory well earned. Other cyclists cheer and smile for him
People move around in front of train cabins on a boring evening full of goodbyes. Loved ones leaving empty space behind
A man and a woman performing a traditional dance experience  a moment of connection in front of an audience
The skilled surfer rides upon the waves and exhibits his tricks as if it brings color to his life.
The small puppy grips a tennis ball in its jaws and walk proudly as if it is a huge achievement
A skinny dog runs with a red frisbee in its mouth in a peaceful field of grass.
The skier has set off to ski but he is not confident. Everyone else looks not so interested in his efforts.
The white and black dog carries a big stick and is determined to take it to the destination. He can not fail
The rally is filled with patriotic emotion and overwhelming amount to devotion to the nation
Multiple emergency respondents see the explosion from a far, knowing that they could not do any thing to stop it. They feel scared and helpless
few people stand on the bridge looking at the jeep that swings by it. It might fall any time.
The small dog runs past the big one, who shows no interest in playing with it. The small one has to do on its own for now.
The lady in swimsuits leans down a bit too close to the counter to read it. Maybe she should take off those sun glasses to see better
The two dogs fight over the one toy they have. There with either be one winner or none, that the fate of it
The man and his faithful dog on a boat. They are out for a peaceful day to fish and relax.
The performer rides a unicycle and performs ticks to bring life to the rally. The audience love it
